title: calceolaria palustris subsp. micrantha
intro:
Calceolaria palustris subsp. micrantha, commonly known as marsh pocketbook or small-flowered marsh slipper, is a plant species belonging to the Calceolaria genus. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of various conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal issues. The therapeutic actions of Calceolaria palustris subsp. micrantha include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic effects, making it a potential remedy for pain relief and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
